items.summary: Transguard Group is interviewing chauffeur drivers on 17-18 October at the EKCD depot in Umm Ramool, and security guards on 17 and 19-22 October at its Jebel Ali accommodation, 8am-1pm.
items.title: Transguard walk-ins for security guards and chauffeurs, 17-22 October
items.where: Guards: Accommodation 6, Jebel Ali; chauffeurs: EKCD Depot, Umm Ramool

items.summary: Operon Middle East is holding walk-ins on 17-18 October (10am-4pm) for MEP supervisors, electricians, AC, BMS, AV and multi technicians, plumbers, masons, carpenters and painters.
items.title: Operon Middle East walk-in for MEP and finishing trades

items.summary: Ejadah Asset Management (Dubai Holding's FM group, parent of Idama) is running daily walk-ins for lifeguards from 15 to 19 October, 10am-3pm, in Al Quoz.
items.title: Ejadah recruiting lifeguards at Al Quoz walk-ins until 19 October

items.summary: Abu Dhabi's Khazna Data Centers aims to run its mechanical cooling load on 50% carbon-free electricity by 2030 and 100% by 2035, up from 27% in 2025; new facilities are designed for a PUE of 1.5 or lower and recycled water met about a fifth of cooling water needs last year.
items.title: Khazna targets 100% carbon-free power for data-centre cooling by 2035

items.summary: The Emirates National Schools campus in Mohamed bin Zayed City, Abu Dhabi, achieved LEED Platinum, reported as the first school campus in the Middle East to reach the top rating, recognising its energy and water efficiency and indoor environment.
items.title: Emirates National Schools MBZ City campus earns LEED Platinum

items.summary: Under Dubai Law No. 3 of 2026, Building Quality and Safety Certificates will be valid for 10 years for buildings aged 20 to under 40 years and five years for buildings 40 years or older, with a phased rollout and inspections.
items.title: Dubai Municipality sets validity periods for building safety certificates

items.summary: Empower has started building a 23,400 refrigeration-ton district cooling plant in Al Sufouh 2, Dubai, under its in-house projects team, with completion targeted for Q3 2027.
items.title: Empower building 23,400 RT cooling plant in Al Sufouh 2
